verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Meteor Explosion as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki, with a close-range strike starter, Ki binding effect, pillar finisher, 8-hit sequence, and knockback.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Meteor Explosion is obtainable by the Future Warrior from Parallel Quest 149 — Clash of the Clones. Independent reference material identifies PQ149 as the Xenoverse 2 acquisition route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ reward route but do not provide explicit evidence sufficient to assert an Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Meteor Explosion is kept distinct from Comet Strike, DUAL Meteor Explosion, and similarly named Meteor techniques.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages are not promoted as canonical database values because observed damage can depend on character stats and version conditions.

records.name: Meteor Explosion
records.character_source: Gogeta (DB Super); SSGSS Gogeta - Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 149 — Clash of the Clones
records.skill_description: Kick the opponent upward, bind them with Ki, then attack with a giant pillar of Ki at close range.
records.mechanics_notes: The attack begins with a flip kick. If the kick connects, the opponent is bound in a pillar of Ki for the remaining sequence, dealing 8 hits before knockback. Comet Strike can immediately set up an Ultimate, including Meteor Explosion, when its third hit connects.
records.combo_notes: Designed to follow Comet Strike when its third hit connects.
